Mutations:

The PR supplies no mutation record. I ran two independent mutations in a temporary copy of the laser module. The harness used the review's compiled libraries. The review checkout did not change.

1. Admit zero power (`> 0.0` to `>= 0.0`): RED. `the_power_is_refused_by_name_outside_its_range` failed.
2. Halve the kerf in `as_sheet`: RED. `the_laser_cuts_what_the_waterjet_cuts_and_speaks_as_the_laser` failed its expected kerf-note assertion.

The original harness passed all four laser tests before the mutations. After restoration, all four passed again: GREEN. A missing proc-macro search path stopped the first harness compile attempt. After the harness path correction, the baseline and mutation runs completed.

Goldens moved: none. The existing waterjet golden is unchanged and passes. No UI screenshots are required for this diff.

Heavy lanes: not run locally. This P4 PR requires no targeted heavy step. The author's [downstream heavy report](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/4273#issuecomment-7210924878) concerns #4288 and reports the swarf failure tracked in #4315. I did not use that report as verification of this exact head. The body can remove its statement that heavy lanes are owed before ready; current upstream rules do not require that run. This is non-blocking.

Requested changes: none. The draft state, labels, title, and contributor branch remain unchanged under the maintainer's instructions. A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
